title: NHTSA NCAP full-frontal rigid-barrier midsize reference

source.report: Update to Future Midsize Lightweight Vehicle Findings in Response to Manufacturer Review and IIHS Small-Overlap Testing

reference_vehicle.usage: External correlation source only; CrashVector does not expose the production model as a selectable vehicle type.

published_observations.notes: The report describes the test pulse as about 120 ms and the driver-compartment intrusions as minuscule. Pedal and foot-rest measurements are not equivalent to CrashVector's structural safety-cell beam-deformation proxy.

pulse_duration_s.basis: Project engineering corridor around the published approximately 120 ms pulse duration.

delta_v_kmh.basis: Rigid-barrier longitudinal velocity-change consistency corridor around the 56.5 km/h test condition.

safety_cell_proxy_mm.basis: CrashVector-only structural proxy. This is deliberately not labelled as pedal, foot-rest, or occupant-space intrusion.

scope.warning: Passing this reference is a limited structural correlation check, not vehicle certification, occupant-injury validation, or manufacturer-specific crash prediction.
